scenarios.title: Generation identity and isolation
actions: Open Settings > General.
Locate LightBI NEXT · Internal panel.
expected: Channel is Internal/NEXT.
Generation ID and parent generation are visible.
Core and control-plane SHAs are pinned.
Isolation status is OK; production distribution/update scopes are not used.
failIf: Panel is absent in an internal build.
Isolation shows BLOCKED.
Any production infrastructure scope is shown.

scenarios.title: Single-file revenue understanding
actions: Import Sales_ERP_May_2026.xlsx.
Run the available revenue perspective/analysis.
expected: Verified source row count is 1500.
Revenue total is 22,973,896,244.
Revenue analysis is executable from governed source evidence.
failIf: Revenue is calculated from preview/sample-only rows.
Revenue total differs from the golden answer.

scenarios.title: Deep BA and drill evidence
actions: Open the governed revenue result in Investigation/Deep BA.
Open a drill/evidence view for a selected result.
expected: Deep BA remains tied to the selected governed metric.
Drill/evidence shows source-bound rows rather than unrelated chart data.
failIf: A different metric is silently substituted.
Evidence cannot identify its source scope.

scenarios.title: Excel Analysis/Pivot export
actions: From a governed analysis, export Excel analysis/Pivot.
Open the workbook in Excel/LibreOffice.
expected: Workbook contains Analysis Overview, Analysis Summary and Pivot View.
Pivot View references governed Analysis Summary values instead of recomputing raw multi-source data.
Source Lineage and Decision Notes are present when applicable.
Export completes without an ANALYSIS_WORKBOOK_DECISION_PLAN_PERSPECTIVE_MISMATCH identity error.
failIf: Workbook is corrupt.
Pivot View invents a different metric total.
ANALYSIS_WORKBOOK_DECISION_PLAN_PERSPECTIVE_MISMATCH is shown while the Deep BA panel and governed chart belong to the same perspective.

scenarios.title: May vs June period comparison
actions: Import both monthly Sales files as a governed period pair.
Run period revenue variance.
expected: May revenue is 22,973,896,244.
June revenue is 20,637,539,164.
Revenue delta is -2,336,357,080.
failIf: Files are blindly row-joined.
Period identity is lost or reversed.

scenarios.title: Governed commerce multi-source
actions: Import May Sales, Accounting and Logistics sources.
Review/accept only the governed relationship path exposed by LightBI.
Run the available cross-source reconciliation.
expected: Sales revenue is 22,973,896,244.
Accounting net revenue is 22,973,896,244.
Revenue gap is 0.
Delivery fee is 147,925,000.
Gross profit is 3,075,721,244.
failIf: LightBI performs an arbitrary join based only on similar column names.
Cross-source evidence loses role/source identity.

scenarios.title: Power BI clean handoff
actions: Prepare the canonical clean copy in Datasets.
Choose Save Power BI package as… and open the exported workbook.
expected: Clean Data and Data Dictionary sheets are present.
The package uses the canonical clean source rather than chart preview rows.
failIf: Original source is modified.
Export rows are only a sampled preview.

scenarios.title: Excel analysis with clean-data attachment
actions: Run a governed analysis and hand it to Datasets.
Prepare clean data, then choose Save Excel analysis / Pivot as….
expected: Workbook contains analysis sheets plus Clean Data, Data Dictionary, Transformation Audit and Clean Handoff Manifest.
Analysis and clean-data lineage refer to the same current source identity.
failIf: Analysis belongs to a previous dataset/session.
Clean-data sheets are attached without canonical handoff context.

scenarios.title: Workspace save, restart and restore
actions: Run a governed analysis and save the workspace session.
Close LightBI completely.
Open LightBI and restore the saved session.
expected: Source is reloaded/re-inspected.
AnalysisSessionIdentity metadata can be restored only after source identity revalidation.
Old execution authority and transient Excel export plan are not silently restored.
failIf: A saved result becomes current authority without revalidation.
Export is immediately enabled from a stale transient plan.

scenarios.title: Same filename, changed content rejection
actions: Save a session using the May Sales source.
Outside the repository, copy the June fixture and rename the copy to Sales_ERP_May_2026.xlsx.
Point the restored workspace at that renamed copy.
expected: Fingerprint/generation revalidation detects that the content changed.
Saved analysis is history only; current export/decision authority is not restored.
failIf: Filename equality is treated as source identity.
The May analysis is authorized against June content.
scenarios.temporaryArtifactPolicy: The renamed file is created only in the tester's temporary folder and is never committed.

scenarios.title: Internal generation manifest provenance
actions: Record the generation ID shown by the app.
Archive the generated lightbi-generation.json with the test result.
expected: Manifest uses lightbi.generation.v1.
Core/source/control-plane commits are full immutable SHAs.
Parent generation, build timestamp and test-pack version are populated.
failIf: A commit is unknown/short.
Parent generation is missing.

scenarios.title: Internal infrastructure isolation
actions: Review NEXT diagnostics and deployment environment before acceptance.
expected: Database, Redis, data, analytics, releases and integrations scopes are internal.
Distribution origin and update channel are internal and not production.
failIf: Any NEXT writable state points at production.

scenarios.title: Successor restart continuity
actions: Run smoke analysis, save workspace, restart the entire internal app/runtime stack, and restore.
expected: Workspace metadata survives.
Canonical source is revalidated.
No stale execution authority is revived.
failIf: Restart loses durable workspace metadata unexpectedly.
Restart reuses stale analysis authority.

scenarios.title: Promotion evidence bundle
actions: Complete all SMOKE scenarios and required FEATURE scenarios.
Attach generation manifest and pass/fail record.
expected: Every accepted result names exactly one generation ID.
Promotion decision refers to immutable core/control-plane commits and the same UAT pack version.
failIf: Acceptance mixes results from multiple unidentified builds.
A rebuilt artifact cannot be traced to the tested generation.
